headline: Weathered Expanse and Fisherman's Row Lead the Strongpoint Fighting
war_summary: Since the previous bulletin, Fisherman's Row has turned hotter still: eight strongpoint changes were logged in the latest two-hour watch, and nineteen in the last six, with Eidolo and Black Well repeatedly in the reports. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest theatre of the day, recording eleven shifts in the latest two hours and forty-nine in the past twenty-four. Stlican Shelf, which had lapsed into quiet, has stirred anew with five changes in the latest two-hour watch, and Mooring County has also shown recent action, logging four shifts in that same window. Callahan's Passage and Farranac Coast each carry recent flips from the past three hours, while Stonecradle remains a heavily bloodied but quieter sector after earlier fighting. Casualty returns remain heavy along the Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County and Callahan's Passage fronts. The campaign has not yet ended: neither side has reached the required thirty-four victory towns.
